title: 识别小国
problem_statement_md:
你是一名旅游经理，需要一个能识别小国家的程序。
如果一个国家的人口在10000以下，面积在10000公顷以下，就被认为是小国。
给定的程序将输入人口和面积。
 
清完成该程序，如果两个条件都满足，则输出 "**小国**“。否则不要输出任何内容。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header]
 
You're a tour manager and need a program that will identify small countries.
A country is considered small if its population is under 10000 and its area is under 10000 hectares.
The given program takes population and area as input.
 
[b]Task[/b]
Complete the program to output "[b]small country" [/b]if both conditions are met. Don't output anything otherwise.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
9955
7522

[b]Sample Output[/b]
small country

[note] Use [b]&&[/b] to combine conditions.[/note]
